# Black metal axe

Internal ID: AxeBlackMetal | Type: Axe | Source: Forge | Usage: Wood cutting | Wielding: One-handed | Crafting Materials: Black metal x30, Linen thread x15 | Attack speed: 2.0 s | Chain last hit: 2x damage, +20% knockback | Hitbox: 2.2 range, 90 angle, 0.6 height, vertical, no multitarget penalty | Movement speed: -5%

# Introduction

The Black metal axe is the fifth one-handed axe. It can be used to chop down Beech, Birch, Oak, Fir, Pine, Ancient, Yggdrasil and Scorched Trees.
Its primary attack is a 3-hit attack combo with double damage on the last hit. Its secondary attack is a slow but powerful overhead swing. This is perfect for removing tree stumps that are too low to hit with a normal swing.
